result:
Daniel's September 7 Farmer edit is cleanup of unwanted opaque pixels at the feet, not a new colour or character-design choice. The saved sheet is already on main as 5dadbf8 and exactly matches sprite ledger step 2. See docs/design/evidence/farmer_pixel_edit_comparison.png for original, current, and marked changes over ground.

A pixel diff of ledger step 0 against step 2 finds 56 pixels changed across 14 of 16 frames, all opaque to transparent: 52 light cream #f8f4e6, three peach #f6ddc4, and one violet #5c4e92. They are confined to frame-local x 20–26, y 39–44 of the 48×48 cells, between or beside the boots. The visible effect is that the ground shows through the stance. No face, outfit, pose, or palette was redesigned. The changed opaque boundary makes the ledger's silhouette flag technically correct, but the body's shape is intact.

The September 3 edit removed 17 pixels in three down-facing frames. September 7 changed another 41 pixels relative to that saved step: 40 more erasures and one peach pixel restored. The first 17 erasures persisted. The prior claim that they had been lost and re-erased is disproved by the snapshots.

This is consistent with the guide's coloured-outline direction and illustrates the ground-contact question already noted in its unsigned hand-edit evidence section; the guide does not yet set a transparency rule. Daniel described an occluding background error, and the pixels support that reading. Keep this as look-session evidence; no style-guide amendment or additional art decision is needed for this edit. A broader source and sheet audit is separate work, and this diff alone does not prove which pipeline step produced the opaque pockets.

follow_ups.first_action: Use the committed Farmer comparison and the existing unsigned-guide hand-edit note to show how transparent gaps at the feet affect ground contact; defer any rule change until Daniel reviews the look.
follow_ups.why: The visual comparison makes the effect concrete without treating cleanup as a new style choice.

recommend.question: Is the white-pixels problem material for the look session, or just a bug to fix?
recommend.answer: Treat this edit as cleanup. The Farmer sheet is already committed; use the comparison as evidence during the planned look session and let the separate audit trace any broader defect.
recommend.why: The final sheet only removes unwanted opaque pixels from the ground-contact gap relative to the original; it adds no design element. The saved image is already committed.
recommend.instead: A transparency rule can be considered during the planned look session; the current guide is still unsigned.
